Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

manifoldsculpting 1.2.1

  • Initial version.

  • manifold_sculpting() implements Manifold Sculpting (Gashler, Ventura and Martinez, 2008), following the reference implementation of the authors in the Waffles library. The neighbor search and the iterations are written in C++. All the dimensions of the data are kept during the iterations at the cost of the preserved ones only, and nstart runs the algorithm several times and keeps the embedding with the lowest error.

  • predict() embeds new samples from their nearest training samples.

  • step_manifold_sculpting() is a recipes step, with the tuning parameters num_comp, neighbors and squishing_rate().

  • sim_swiss_roll() and sim_s_curve() simulate the test manifolds of the paper.

  • New vignette("comparison") compares Manifold Sculpting with Isomap, LLE, t-SNE, UMAP, nonlinear PCA and kernel PCA. It is precomputed, from vignettes/comparison.Rmd.orig, by vignettes/precompute.R.

  • New vignette("spectroscopy") applies Manifold Sculpting to the NIR spectra of meat of the modeldata package, with the tidyverse and tidymodels: it unfolds the arch of the PCA scores, and compares principal component regression with regression on the embedding for the prediction of protein.

Developed by Christian L. Goueguel.
